core_intent: The 24 paired themes contain current first-person declarative statements. Benign examples describe ordinary worry or functioning; contrast examples explicitly describe distress, threat, coercion or self-injury. These are intended synthetic concern labels, not diagnoses or independently verified gold.
issue: The fictional designation is supplied only by the assistant context. The minor quotes and evaluates a statement without explicitly identifying it as a fictional line. Even if the intended scene reading is plausible, this may teach suppression of an actual disclosure based on assistant framing. Structural policy agreement cannot resolve that ambiguity.
required_revision: Create a separate retained continuation. In fictional rows, make the minor explicitly identify the character/line as fictional in both prior and focal messages; preserve every core, label, factor combination and direct input. Preserve actual prior quoted statements for retractions. Re-tokenize and independently verify the entire continued population.
policy_note: The unchanged policy conservatively requests review for retraction of a concern even within fiction. Labels must not be changed to force fictional retractions negative.
